import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 205, M = N * N;
    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int[] from = new int[M];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] cap = new int[M];
    static int[] prev = new int[M];
    static int ec = 0;
    static int[][] a = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] b = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] red = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] block = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
    static int[] dred = new int[N * N];
    static int[] cnt = new int[1];
    static int[] seen = new int[N * N];
    static int[] q = new int[N * N];
    static int[] dx = new int[]{0, -1, 0, 1};
    static int[] dy = new int[]{1, 0, -1, 0};

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int uv, int vu) {
        from[ec] = u;
        to[ec] = v;
        cap[ec] = uv;
        prev[ec] = head[u];
        head[u] = ec++;
        from[ec] = v;
        to[ec] = u;
        cap[ec] = vu;
        prev[ec] = head[v];
        head[v] = ec++;
    }

    static int dfs(int v, int sink, int flow) {
        if (v == sink)
            return flow;
        if (seen[v]++)
            return 0;
        for (int e = head[v]; e != -1; e = prev[e]) {
            if (cap[e] > 0) {
                int u = to[e];
                int x = dfs(u, sink, Math.min(flow, cap[e]));
                if (x > 0) {
                    cap[e] -= x;
                    cap[e ^ 1] += x;
                    return x;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        int res = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            int h = 0;
            int t = 0;
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            int add = dfs(source, sink);
            res += add;
            if (add == 0)
                break;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int dt = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        Arrays.fill(dis, 63);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            dis[i][i] = 0;
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char foo = br.readLine().charAt(0);
                if (foo == 'Y')
                    block[x][y] = 1;
                else if (foo == 'Z')
                    red[x][y] = 1;
                else
                    a[x][y] = foo - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < n; y++) {
                char foo = br.readLine().charAt(0);
                if (foo != 'Y' && foo != 'Z') {
                    b[x][y] = foo - '0';
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int i = x + dx[d];
                        int j = y + dy[d];
                        if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < n && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j]) {
                            dis[x * n + y][i * n + j] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int m = n * n;
        for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (dis[i][k] + dis[k][j] < dis[i][j])
                        dis[i][j] = dis[i][k] + dis[k][j];
                }
            }
        }
        int h = 0;
        int t = 0;
        Arrays.fill(dred, 63);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (red[i][j]) {
                    q[t++] = i * n + j;
                    dred[i * n + j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        while (h != t) {
            int cur = q[h++];
            int x = cur / n;
            int y = cur % n;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int i = x + dx[d];
                int j = y + dy[d];
                if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < n && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j] && dred[i * n + j] > 1000000000) {
                    dred[i * n + j] = dred[x * n + y] + 1;
                    q[t++] = i * n + j;
                }
            }
        }
        int sink = N - 1;
        int source = N - 2;
        for (int cur = 0; cur < m; cur++) {
            Arrays.fill(seen, 0);
            h = 0;
            t = 0;
            int sx = cur / n;
            int sy = cur % n;
            if (block[sx][sy] || red[sx][sy])
                continue;
            q[t++] = sx * n + sy;
            seen[cur] = 1;
            while (h != t) {
                int x = q[h]. / n;
                int y = q[h++]. % n;
                if (dis[cur][x * n + y] <= dt)
                    addEdge(cur << 1, (x * n + y) << 1 | 1, 1000, 0);
                if (dis[cur][x * n + y] == dred[x * n + y])
                    continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int i = x + dx[d];
                    int j = y + dy[d];
                    int id = i * n + j;
                    if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < n && j < n && !block[i][j] && !red[i][j] && dis[cur][id] <= dred[id] && dis[cur][id] <= dt && dis[cur][id] > dis[cur][x * n + y] && !seen[id]) {
                        q[t++] = i * n + j;
                        seen[id] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            addEdge(source, i << 1, a[i / n][i % n], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++)
            addEdge(i << 1 | 1, sink, b[i / n][i % n], 0);
        pw.println(maxFlow(source, sink));
        pw.close();
    }
}
